name: Audio Leveler: Start Job
description: Runs Audio Leveler's background work under fppd. The Audio Leveler page uses it; you don't need to. Queued job: starts the measuring, leveling or restoring job queued on the page in the last 30 seconds (on its own it does nothing). Check videos for sound: looks at any video not checked yet. Level new uploads: levels new and replaced songs now, only if automatic leveling is switched on.
